theHighPriestess.name: The High Priestess
theHighPriestess.intro: Guardian of the sanctuary behind the veil, the High Priestess is the silent memory between the two pillars of the Temple. Explore each symbol of the card.

pillarB.title: The Pillar B (Boaz)
pillarB.description: The black pillar of Boaz represents severity, contraction and form. It is the principle that delimits and gives structure, without which no manifestation can exist.

pillarJ.title: The Pillar J (Jachin)
pillarJ.description: The white pillar of Jachin represents mercy, expansion and force. It is the principle that gives and expands, making room for life to flourish.

veilPomegranates.title: The Veil with Pomegranates
veilPomegranates.description: The veil embroidered with pomegranates and palms hides the sanctum: knowledge reveals itself only to those who pass through — not to those who peep. The pomegranates evoke Persephone and the underworlds.

water.title: The Sea Behind the Veil
water.description: Between the pillars, beyond the veil, stretches the ocean: the collective unconscious, the matrix of every form not yet manifested.

scroll.title: The TORA Scroll
scroll.description: Partly hidden in her lap, the scroll of the Law rests: wisdom exists, but remains veiled — intuition before letter.

crown.title: The Lunar Crown
crown.description: The crescent horns embrace the solar disc: the High Priestess unites Moon and Sun, reception and radiation, in the same gesture of Hathor.

solarCross.title: The Solar Cross on Her Chest
solarCross.description: The equal-armed cross over her heart: the axis of balance between opposites, the still point of the center.

crescentMoon.title: The Moon at Her Feet
crescentMoon.description: The lunar crescent beneath her robes: everything here is governed by the Moon — cycles, tides, the unconscious and the deep feminine.

temperance.name: Temperance
temperance.intro: The angel of alchemy balances the waters of the soul between two cups, uniting opposites on the middle path. Explore each symbol of the card.

crownHalo.title: Solar Crown / Halo
crownHalo.description: The solar disc on the brow and the radiant halo mark illumination and the divine presence. Temperance acts guided by the light of higher consciousness.

wings.title: Wings
wings.description: The great wings reveal the angelic nature and the ability to move between heaven and earth, spirit and matter.

triangleSquare.title: Triangle in the Square
triangleSquare.description: The triangle (fire, spirit) inscribed in the square (matter, the four elements) symbolizes spirit manifested and contained within form — balance between the divine and the material.

cupsWater.title: The Cups and the Water
cupsWater.description: Water flowing between the two cups, often on an impossible diagonal, represents the alchemical fusion of opposites: conscious and unconscious, past and future. The essence of temperance — mixing in the right measure.

sunMountain.title: Sun, Mountains and the Path
sunMountain.description: In the background, the rising sun over the mountains and the winding path point to the journey toward spiritual realization — the distant golden crown as the goal.

irises.title: Irises
irises.description: The yellow irises allude to Iris, messenger of the gods and goddess of the rainbow, linking the divine and human worlds. They reinforce communication and harmony.

waterFeet.title: The Water at the Feet
waterFeet.description: One foot submerged in water (the unconscious, emotion) and the other firm on land (the conscious, the material) show the perfect balance between the two worlds.

theFool.name: The Fool
theFool.intro: On the edge of the abyss, the eternal beginner sets out with no visible baggage — only faith, instinct and the light that guides him. Explore each symbol of the card.

sun.title: The Radiant Sun
sun.description: The sun shines behind the Fool's shoulder: the divine blessing that accompanies whoever dares the leap. Its light is the inner certainty that needs no planning.

mountains.title: The Snowy Mountains
mountains.description: The snow-capped peaks in the distance are the heights of spiritual aspiration — the far-off goal the traveler does not even need to face yet; it is enough to walk.

cliff.title: The Cliff
cliff.description: The abyss at the edge of the step is the unknown. The Fool does not notice it — or does not mind: faith does not calculate, it trusts. This is the zero point of every journey.

bundle.title: The Bundle on the Staff
bundle.description: The colorful bundle hanging from the staff carries the archetypes of the collective unconscious — the heritage every traveler carries without knowing what it holds.

whiteRose.title: The White Rose
whiteRose.description: In his left hand, the white rose is the purity of intention and the untouched innocence: the unblemished principle of every beginning.

motleyTunic.title: The Motley Tunic
motleyTunic.description: The Fool's patchwork coat of many colors is a harlequin's garment: every patch is a life, a mask, a role he has tried on without clinging to any of them. The tunic reminds us that the world is play and festival — whoever wears every color need not pick a single identity before setting out.

mismatchedLeggings.title: The Mismatched Legs
mismatchedLeggings.description: The Fool's two legs do not match: one color on each side, one stride longer than the other. This asymmetry is the signature of one who walks before being ready — the crooked step keeps the motion going, and it is the imbalance that pushes him into the unknown. It is not carelessness: it is courage in transit.

jesterCap.title: The Fool's Cap
jesterCap.description: The court jester's cap is the Fool's only crown: to reign without a throne, over nothing, starting from zero. The ridiculous hat is wisdom in disguise — whoever accepts being a fool before the world is free to learn everything anew.

dog.title: The Little White Dog
dog.description: The dog leaping at the Fool's feet is faithful instinct — and also a warning: the loyalty of the animal body accompanies, barks and protects, but does not decide the leap.

feather.title: The Red Feather
feather.description: The red feather on his cap recalls the lightness required: vibrant courage, without the weight of certainties.

theMagician.name: The Magician
theMagician.intro: As above, so below: the Magician is the channel between heaven and earth, with every tool of creation within reach. Explore each symbol of the card.

infinity.title: The Infinity Symbol
infinity.description: The vertical lemniscate above his head is the key to the arcana: an unlimited mind, complete command of the vocabulary of creation.

wand.title: The Raised Wand
wand.description: The wand raised in his right hand draws down divine force; the Magician does not own it, he only conducts it.

pointingHand.title: The Hand Pointing Down
pointingHand.description: His free hand points to the earth: the hermetic principle 'as above, so below' — every inspiration must become flesh in matter.

tableTools.title: The Table and the Four Suits
tableTools.description: On the table lie cup, sword, wand and pentacle: the four elements — emotion, mind, will and body — the tools of manifestation.

roseGarden.title: The Rose Garden
roseGarden.description: Roses and lilies bloom before the table: desire and purity cultivated side by side — matter already transmuted into paradise.

serpentBelt.title: The Serpent Belt
serpentBelt.description: The serpent biting its own tail (ouroboros) at his waist: eternity and self-renewal — power held within a closed circle.

theEmpress.name: The Empress
theEmpress.intro: Sovereign of fertile nature, the Empress reigns over wheat, waters and all that blooms. Explore each symbol of the card.

starCrown.title: The Crown of Twelve Stars
starCrown.description: Twelve stars: the complete zodiac — she governs the cyclical time of seasons and gestations.

venusShield.title: The Shield of Venus
venusShield.description: The heart-shaped shield bearing the symbol of Venus: love as foundation — beauty, affection and vital magnetism.

scepter.title: The Scepter
scepter.description: The globe-topped scepter: gentle authority over the world of forms — her hand does not even need to grip it tightly.

wheatField.title: The Wheat Field
wheatField.description: The ripe wheat at the foot of the throne: Demeter and the abundance of the Mother — work that bears fruit without haste.

pomegranateRobe.title: The Pomegranates of Her Robe
pomegranateRobe.description: The dress patterned with pomegranates (echoing the High Priestess's veil): fertility, many children, many seeds — the multiplication of the one.

riverTrees.title: The River and the Trees
riverTrees.description: In the background, the waterfall and the forest: life flowing without a dam — nature renewing itself within its own rhythm.

theEmperor.name: The Emperor
theEmperor.intro: The archetype of the Father: structure, law and iron will enthroned upon power.

ramHeads.title: The Rams of the Throne
ramHeads.description: The rams' heads carved into the arms of the throne: Aries and Mars — the initiating force, the impulse that opens every new cycle.

ankh.title: The Ankh Scepter
ankh.description: The ankh cross is the life the Emperor grants and sustains: his power exists to organize and preserve existence, not to destroy it.

orb.title: The Orb
orb.description: In his left hand, the globe of dominion: the world under conscious control — complete vision, government from afar.

armor.title: The Armor Beneath the Mantle
armor.description: Under the red robes, the breastplate: the ruler remains a warrior within even when serene without — the rigidity that protects and also imprisons.

beardCrown.title: The Beard and the Crown
beardCrown.description: The long white beard is the wisdom accumulated by time; the golden crown, the right to command inherited from experience — not from whim.

mountains.title: The Arid Mountains
mountains.description: The rocky desert in the background: the realm of form in its driest, most defined state — clear limits, without dissolution.

theHierophant.name: The Hierophant
theHierophant.intro: The priest of tradition: between the temple columns, he blesses and keeps the keys of the established mystery.

tripleCrown.title: The Triple Crown
tripleCrown.description: The three bands of the tiara: the three worlds — physical, mental and spiritual — under a single authority; pope, emperor and god in one office.

tripleCross.title: The Triple Cross
tripleCross.description: The staff with three crossbars: blessing descends through every level of existence, from heaven to earth.

crossedKeys.title: The Crossed Keys
crossedKeys.description: Of gold and silver, sun and moon: the keys that open the outer and inner mysteries — the exoteric and the esoteric set in a cross.

blessingHand.title: The Hand in Blessing
blessingHand.description: The two raised fingers: the gesture of teaching and blessing — doctrine handed down from hand to hand, from generation to generation.

acolytes.title: The Two Monks
acolytes.description: The tonsured initiates in embroidered cloaks — obedience and devotion: tradition exists only because there are those who receive it.

pillars.title: The Temple Pillars
pillars.description: Unlike those of the High Priestess (J and B), these belong to the established: the visible church, the structure that sustains the sacred in matter.

theChariot.name: The Chariot
theChariot.intro: A serene victor of battles past, the charioteer drives opposing sphinxes without reins — by will alone.

starryCanopy.title: The Starry Canopy
starryCanopy.description: The woven sky that roofs the chariot: celestial protection and destinies — the stars that accompany those who move with purpose.

sphinxes.title: The White and Black Sphinxes
sphinxes.description: The opposing forces the charioteer does not tame by force but orchestrates by direction: without reins, intention governs.

wingedSun.title: The Winged Solar Disc
wingedSun.description: The Egyptian emblem at the front of the chariot: the uplifted heart — the victory of one who has mastered himself before conquering the world.

shoulderMoons.title: The Moons on His Shoulders
shoulderMoons.description: The crescents on his shoulder plates: intuition and receptivity traveling alongside determination — the lunar in the service of the solar.

cityWalls.title: The City Behind
cityWalls.description: The walls are left behind: what has been conquered already lies at the rear; the Chariot advances through open ground — new challenges, without walls.

squareEmblem.title: The Square on His Chest
squareEmblem.description: The square symbol on his breastplate: the squared will — four elements, four directions — geometric firmness at the center of action.

strength.name: Strength
strength.intro: Not the strength that subjugates, but the one that tames by gentleness — roses where there would be chains.

infinity.title: The Infinity Above Her Head
infinity.description: The same lemniscate worn by the Magician, now on the woman's brow: spiritual strength — the power that comes from above, not from muscle.

lionMouth.title: The Lion's Mouth
lionMouth.description: Her fingers intertwined with the lion's jaws: raw instinct is not beaten down but embraced — the animal ego tamed by affectionate firmness.

roseGarland.title: The Garland of Roses
roseGarland.description: Roses crown her head and waist: the bonds here are bonds of beauty — desire (red) transformed into conscious adornment.

redRibbon.title: The Red Ribbon
redRibbon.description: The red sash at her waist: appetite is not eliminated in the taming — only tied in a graceful bow.

whiteRobe.title: The White Robe
whiteRobe.description: The simple tunic: purity of intention — nothing to defend, no armor; courage unarmed.

mountains.title: The Mountains Behind
mountains.description: The horizon of peaks in the background: the task is long — taming the lion is daily practice, not a single event.

theHermit.name: The Hermit
theHermit.intro: On the snowy peak of attainment, the sage looks within: the light he carries is the one he finds.

lanternStar.title: The Lantern and the Seal of Solomon
lanternStar.description: Raised to eye level, the lantern displays the hexagram: the wisdom sought outside shines here within — to seek is to remember.

staff.title: The Staff
staff.description: The pilgrim's staff is the column that sustains the solitary walk — and the humble scepter of one who already reigns over himself.

grayHood.title: The Gray Hood
grayHood.description: The faded cloak, without a crest: the anonymity of the true master — knowledge is not displayed, it is kindled in others.

mountainPeak.title: The Mountain Peak
mountainPeak.description: He stands on the summit that every previous arcana climbed: from such a height, what was urgent looks small — and still he keeps searching.

beardedFace.title: The Face of the Sage
beardedFace.description: The white beard and the lowered gaze: an age that does not weigh — time distilled into understanding, silence as his mother tongue.

theLovers.name: The Lovers
theLovers.intro: Under Raphael's blessing, the soul chooses: the flaming tree and the serpent's tree, the man and the woman, desire and consciousness.

angel.title: The Angel Raphael
angel.description: With wings spread, Raphael — "God heals" — presides over the union: love as a regenerative force and a conscious choice, not blind yearning.

sun.title: The Sun
sun.description: The golden disc behind the angel: the truth that illuminates every authentic union — nothing to hide beneath the full light.

flamingTree.title: The Flaming Tree
flamingTree.description: Behind the man, the blazing tree is the zeal of the will: the yang fire, the passion that illuminates and devours.

serpentTree.title: The Tree of the Serpent
serpentTree.description: Behind the woman, the tree of knowledge with the serpent coiled around it: received wisdom, yin magnetism — the desire that seduces into experience.

couple.title: The Man and the Woman
couple.description: He looks at her; she looks at the angel: consciousness turned toward the unconscious, the unconscious turned toward spirit — the triangle of every transforming relationship.

mountain.title: The Mountain
mountain.description: The distant peak between the two: union as ascent — the sublime goal reached by two, never alone.

wheelOfFortune.name: Wheel of Fortune
wheelOfFortune.intro: The still axis of eternal return: Anubis rises, Typhon descends — and the Sphinx waits at the top with the answer.

angel.title: The Angel — Matthew
angel.description: In the upper left corner, the angel reads its book: the Man of Aquarius, the fixed air of intelligence. In Matthew, the genealogy that joins heaven and earth — the consciousness that contemplates the turning and recognizes the divine hand within it.

eagle.title: The Eagle — John
eagle.description: At the upper right, the eagle perches on the book: Scorpio, fixed water, the eye that sees the invisible. In John, the Word that was in the beginning — the vision that passes through death and rises above the turning itself.

bull.title: The Ox — Luke
bull.description: At the lower left, the ox rests with its book open: Taurus, fixed earth, the gentle strength that sustains. In Luke, sacrifice and labor — the fertile matter where the wheel finds ground to turn.

lion.title: The Lion — Mark
lion.description: At the lower right, the lion guards the book: Leo, fixed fire, the heart that roars. In Mark, courage and the Kingdom — the fire that drives the turning and refuses to be extinguished.

wheelLetters.title: The Letters of the Wheel
wheelLetters.description: TARO (or ROTA, TORAT) interwoven with the Hebrew letters Yod-Heh-Vav-Heh: the Law that turns — the divine Name that becomes world, the world that, turned, becomes Name again.

alchemicalRim.title: The Alchemical Rim
alchemicalRim.description: Sulfur, mercury, water and salt in the outer quadrants: the wheel is the workshop of the Great Work itself — continuous transmutation.

sphinx.title: The Sphinx at the Top
sphinx.description: Motionless at the highest point, sword raised: the riddle and the balance — the only creature that neither rises nor falls, because it is already the axis.

anubis.title: Anubis Ascending
anubis.description: The Egyptian psychopomp climbs with the wheel: evolution — the soul rising turn by turn, guided by what it learned to honor.

serpentTyphon.title: The Serpent Typhon
serpentTyphon.description: Descending in a spiral: involution, the drag of matter — every ascent has its counterweight going down.

justice.name: Justice
justice.intro: Between the pillars of the law, the sword and the scales: every act weighed with the same stone.

pillarsVeil.title: The Pillars and the Veil
pillarsVeil.description: Behind her, pillars and a veil: Justice acts within structure — the verdict is human, but the court is cosmic.

scales.title: The Scales
scales.description: In her left hand, the beam balanced at zero: exact equilibrium between what was done and what is owed — the mathematics of karma, without pity and without cruelty.

sword.title: The Upright Sword
sword.description: In her right hand, with an impeccable edge: the truth that cuts — to decide is to separate, and judging demands a blade clean of vanity.

crown.title: The Crown
crown.description: The three-tiered crown: thought, word and deed under the same measure — the law that reigns before it punishes.

redMantle.title: The Red Mantle
redMantle.description: Beneath the pale tunic, the red mantle: passion exists, but underlying — the judge feels, and for that very reason weighs with both hands.

theHangedMan.name: The Hanged Man
theHangedMan.intro: Suspended between heaven and earth by the ankle, the voluntary mystic: a surrender that is not defeat.

beam.title: The Tau Beam
beam.description: The gallows shaped like a T — the Tau, sign of salvation: the same cross that punishes is the one that redeems, depending on which side one hangs from.

livingTree.title: The Living Tree
livingTree.description: Green leaves sprout from the timber: the sacrifice is made on a living tree, not on dead wood — every surrender here bears fruit.

halo.title: The Golden Halo
halo.description: Around the inverted head: light is not lost through sacrifice — it intensifies. Illumination through surrender.

crossedLeg.title: The Crossed Leg
crossedLeg.description: The legs trace the numeral 4 — the world of form — and the whole body an inverted cross: matter hung on the spirit's turned perspective, the world read upside down.

boundHands.title: The Hands Bound Behind the Back
boundHands.description: Tied behind the trunk in a triangle: the will that gives itself over — hands that do not grasp allow the heights to fill them.

sereneFace.title: The Serene Face
sereneFace.description: No anguish on the face: the surrender is complete and conscious — whoever chose to hang is not the rope's victim, but its dance partner.

death.name: Death
death.intro: Not the end but the passage: the sun rises between two towers while every hierarchy kneels.

risingSun.title: The Sun Between the Towers
risingSun.description: Between two towers the sun rises — and does not set: the hidden promise of arcanum XIII. Every crossing ends in dawn.

riverBoat.title: The River and the Boat
riverBoat.description: The boat waits on the river: the crossing every soul must make — the ferryman of old now waits; the river never stops flowing, only we stop.

skeletonArmor.title: The Skeleton in Armor
skeletonArmor.description: Bones beneath black armor: what remains when every form falls — the final structure, the invincible that is already bone and therefore fears nothing.

blackHorse.title: The White Horse
blackHorse.description: The "pale" steed of scripture, whiter than any other creature in the arcanum: death rides over the pure — nothing impure reaches the other shore.

bannerRose.title: The Banner of the White Rose
bannerRose.description: The five-petalled rose on the black cloth: life persisting within the symbol of death — transformation, not annihilation; the five senses surrendering.

kneelingFigures.title: Those Who Kneel
kneelingFigures.description: King, woman and child: power, attachment and innocence — the three human reactions before the inevitable: resistance, grief and acceptance.

childFlowers.title: The Child and the Flowers
childFlowers.description: Only the child raises flowers to the rider: innocence welcomes transformation as springtime — death seen by fearless eyes is metamorphosis.

theTower.name: The Tower
theTower.intro: The lightning bolt that strikes down the false crown: no one falls from the Tower by chance — each falls from himself.

towerCrag.title: The Tower on the Crag
towerCrag.description: Upon the bare rock, with no foundations in sight: the structure believed eternal — built on what was unseen, it falls when the unseen shifts.

lightning.title: The Lightning
lightning.description: It descends exactly through the crown of the tower: sudden intervention — truth that asks no leave and strikes first what stood highest, because it rested on the falsest ground.

fallingCrown.title: The Falling Crown
fallingCrown.description: Torn from the top of the tower, still in its fall: every power founded on error adorns itself with what it cannot sustain — authority collapsing along with the structure.

fallingFigures.title: The Two Who Fall
fallingFigures.description: Head over heels, like the Hanged Man — but without halo and without choice: here surrender was not voluntary; awakening arrived as an earthquake.

flamesYods.title: The Yods of Fire
flamesYods.description: Twenty-two tongues of fire shaped like the Hebrew letter Yod: the divine seed scattered through the ruin — the same fire that topples the Tower sows the alphabet of rebuilding (22 letters, 22 paths).

theStar.name: The Star
theStar.intro: After the storm the sky opens: the Giver pours her waters over the earth and over the lake.

greatStar.title: The Great Star
greatStar.description: The larger star with eight rays: hope that does not depend on circumstance — Venus, the morning star, announcing the Sun without being the Sun.

sevenStars.title: The Seven Smaller Stars
sevenStars.description: Seven little suns around her: the seven chakras, the seven classical planets — the intermediate hierarchy between you and the Great Star.

twoJugs.title: The Two Jugs
twoJugs.description: Water poured in two directions — onto the land (the body, the practical) and into the lake (the soul, the unconscious): feeding both worlds from the same source.

ibis.title: The Ibis in the Tree
ibis.description: The bird of Thoth at the water's edge: thought renewing itself — after the purification of the Tower, the first bird to return is serene reflection.

pool.title: The Pool
pool.description: The still water that receives: the unconscious replenished — the psyche that does not ask to understand, only to be bathed.

horizon.title: The Earth and the Horizon
horizon.description: The ground and the limit of the sky: the promise of integration — what descended from above will grow in the soil; hope that becomes a plant.

theMoon.name: The Moon
theMoon.intro: On the path between two towers, what rises from the lake has no name yet: dog, wolf and crayfish answer to the same silence.

moonFace.title: The Moon with a Face
moonFace.description: The disc with a countenance, between straight and wavy rays: borrowed, shifting light — lunar truth changes phase according to who looks at it.

dewDrops.title: The Drops of Dew
dewDrops.description: They fall from sky to earth: inspiration and intuition — the dew that is gathered only at dawn, in silence.

dogWolf.title: The Dog and the Wolf
dogWolf.description: The tame and the wild howl at the same Moon: trained nature and untouched nature react to what they cannot control — they reveal themselves in the night.

crayfish.title: The Crayfish
crayfish.description: Emerging from the lake, between the waters and the path: the oldest floor of the unconscious — the primitive, armored fears that rise only when the light dims.

twoTowers.title: The Two Towers
twoTowers.description: The gateway to the unknown: unfinished portals — the passage between the known and the never-mapped; the path runs between them, not around them.

windingPath.title: The Winding Path
windingPath.description: It climbs, turns, vanishes and reappears: the night journey is no straight line — you cross it by trusting whoever drew the trail this way.

theDevil.name: The Devil
theDevil.intro: In the dark grotto the Goat of Mendes presides: the chains hang loose — the prison is optional.

invertedPentagram.title: The Inverted Pentagram
invertedPentagram.description: The five-pointed star turned upside down: spirit facing the ground — matter adored as a god. The symbol is not evil; it merely points the wrong way.

batWings.title: The Bat's Wings
batWings.description: Night wings that never fly upward, only cast shadow: power confined to the underground — the shadow that prefers the cellar to the sky.

torch.title: The Torch
torch.description: The flame in the raised hand descends upon the captives: inverted "illumination" — awareness used to enslave, fire that burns instead of lighting.

chains.title: The Loose Chains
chains.description: Placed within the captives' reach, yet slack: the central revelation of the arcanum — captivity is self-imposed; no one must remain; it is enough to rise and walk out.

captives.title: The Two Captives
captives.description: The naked man and woman, horned and tailed — the very pair of The Lovers, now in shadow: a bond that was communion has become a fetter; desire, possession.

darkCave.title: The Dark Cave
darkCave.description: A setting with no sky and no horizon: the closed world of material worship — there are no stars here because no one looks up.

theSun.name: The Sun
theSun.intro: The reborn child rides at daybreak: nothing to prove, everything to shine.

sunRays.title: The Sun of Straight Rays
sunRays.description: Unlike the Moon, the rays here do not waver — they are spears of light: full consciousness, without distortion or borrowed light — the source is the center itself.

childHorse.title: The Child on the White Horse
childHorse.description: Naked and free on the white mount: the reborn self — innocence recovered after every crossing; the horse is strength purified in the service of joy.

redBanner.title: The Red Banner
redBanner.description: The child holds the banner of victory — yet does not look at it: triumph that needs no display; the red of vitality streaming without war.

sunflowerWall.title: The Wall of Sunflowers
sunflowerWall.description: Four sunflowers turned toward the child — not toward the sun: all nature recognizes what stands higher; when the Sun is within, even flowers turn to it.

redPlume.title: The Red Plume
redPlume.description: The single feather in the child's hair: a touch of will — freedom is not passivity; it demands a point of fire.

judgement.name: Judgement
judgement.intro: The trumpet sounds over the open coffins: to rise again is to remember where you came from.

angelTrumpet.title: The Angel and the Trumpet
angelTrumpet.description: The sound that wakes the dead: the call — no threat, a summons; the same note that is terror to the old structure is dawn to the soul.

flagCross.title: The Banner on the Trumpet
flagCross.description: The flag bearing the cross, fixed to the instrument: the message that descends — the axis between heaven and earth along which resurrection travels.

risenFamily.title: Those Who Rise
risenFamily.description: Man, woman and child rise from the coffins with open arms: memory, welcome and new beginning — the whole self leaving the old form as one leaves an old bed.

coffins.title: The Floating Coffins
coffins.description: On the water, open, they do not sink: the past that served as a cradle becomes a shell — the old form honored for all it allowed, and left behind with gratitude.

seaMountains.title: The Sea and the Mountains
seaMountains.description: In the background, the unconscious (sea) and the journey to come (mountains): awakening is not the end — it is setting out again, now with open eyes.

theWorld.name: The World
theWorld.intro: Inside the laurel wreath, the dancer contains everything: the four living creatures bear witness to the synthesis.

laurelWreath.title: The Laurel Wreath
laurelWreath.description: The living oval that encloses everything: the mandorla of victory and of the womb — the cosmic uterus where all that was lived is completed, and from which everything begins again.

fourCreatures.title: The Four Living Creatures
fourCreatures.description: Angel, eagle, lion and bull in the clouds of the corners: the same as on the Wheel of Fortune, now without books — the Law has become body; what was studied has been embodied.

dancer.title: The Dancer
dancer.description: The soul celebrating the synthesis: nothing to conquer, everything to dance — the center that exists only in motion, holding the opposites in rotation.

twoWands.title: The Two Wands
twoWands.description: One in each hand: the will that no longer divides — evocation and invocation, doing and receiving, both halves of the same dance.

clouds.title: The Clouds in the Corners
clouds.description: The banks of cloud uphold the living creatures: witness that floats — the world seen from above and from within at once; matter rarefied into consciousness.

aceOfWands.name: Ace of Wands
aceOfWands.intro: A hand emerges from a cloud offering a budding wand: the first impulse, the creative spark and the courage to begin. It is fire in its purest state, still formless and full of promise.

handCloud.title: The Hand in the Cloud
handCloud.description: The gift from above: inspiration arrives as a present, not a conquest. The hand offers the wand, but you must take hold of it.

buddingWand.title: The Budding Wand
buddingWand.description: A living staff still sprouting: will is not dead wood but growing force. Each leaf is an idea ready to unfold.

fallingLeaves.title: The Falling Leaves
fallingLeaves.description: Leaves shaped like the Hebrew letter yod (י), first letter of the divine Name, drift in the air: scattered sparks, seeds of possibility carried by the wind.

castleLandscape.title: The Castle and the Landscape
castleLandscape.description: In the distance a castle on a hill and a fertile valley: the destination the first step has not yet reached but can already see.

twoOfWands.name: Two of Wands
twoOfWands.intro: A man on a battlement holds the world in one hand and a wand in the other, gazing at the sea. Planning, choosing a direction and deciding between what he has and what he could win.

globe.title: The Globe in Hand
globe.description: The world fits in the palm of the one who plans: power, reach and responsibility. The sphere reminds him he must still choose where to set it down.

twoWands.title: The Two Wands
twoWands.description: One held, one fixed to the wall: will in motion and will rooted in place. Between what you carry and what you leave standing, strategy is born.

seaHorizon.title: The Sea and the Horizon
seaHorizon.description: His gaze goes past the walls to the open sea: the ambition to leave known territory without yet knowing what lies on the other side.

roseLilyEmblem.title: The Rose and the Lily
roseLilyEmblem.description: Crossed roses and lilies on the wall: desire (rose) and purity (lily) joined in the same decision. A will that chooses with heart and clarity together.

threeOfWands.name: Three of Wands
threeOfWands.intro: Seen from behind, a man on a cliff watches his ships set sail. The first fruits of a plan in motion: wider vision, confident waiting and expansion.

manFromBehind.title: The Man from Behind
manFromBehind.description: He has done his part and now watches: the trust of one who planted the plan and accepts waiting. Facing the horizon, he leaves the past behind.

threeWands.title: The Three Wands
threeWands.description: Three firm staves in the ground: the foundation is already planted. One serves as support for his hand, showing that will can now stand on its own.

shipsSea.title: The Ships at Sea
shipsSea.description: The vessels carry what was invested toward distant lands: work leaving your hands that will someday return with a yield.

goldenSky.title: The Golden Sky
goldenSky.description: An open yellow sky over the sea: the light of optimism, the promise that the chosen path has room to grow.

fourOfWands.name: Four of Wands
fourOfWands.intro: Four wands hold up a garland of flowers over a couple celebrating before the castle. The feast after the effort: stability, home, welcome and community.

garlandCanopy.title: The Garland
garlandCanopy.description: Flowers and fruit hang between the wands like a festive canopy: the fruit of effort has become a shared celebration.

fourWands.title: The Four Wands
fourWands.description: Four raised pillars form a gateway: the four directions, the four elements, a firm base that shelters joy.

celebratingCouple.title: The Celebrating Couple
celebratingCouple.description: Two figures raise bouquets with open arms: shared joy doubles. An achievement is only complete when celebrated in company.

castleGate.title: The Castle and the Bridge
castleGate.description: In the background, the castle with its bridge and the group approaching: home as refuge and meeting place, open to those who arrive.

fiveOfWands.name: Five of Wands
fiveOfWands.intro: Five young men brandish staves in a struggle with no clear winner. Competition, friction and the confused energy of many wills colliding, which can wear down or sharpen those involved.

crossedStaves.title: The Crossed Staves
crossedStaves.description: No blow lands: the staves cross in the air and cancel each other. The contest spends strength without producing a direction.

fiveYouths.title: The Five Youths
fiveYouths.description: No one is a villain: each fights for his place. The card shows the natural friction of people with strong ideas who have not yet learned to cooperate.

mixedClothing.title: The Mismatched Clothes
mixedClothing.description: Each youth wears different colors and styles: no uniform, no team. Diversity, when unorganized, becomes confusion instead of strength.

unevenGround.title: The Uneven Ground
unevenGround.description: Rough ground and an open clearing: a training field, not a war. The conflict here is a test of strength, not a deadly battle.

sixOfWands.name: Six of Wands
sixOfWands.intro: A rider crowned with laurel returns in triumph, surrounded by a crowd of staves. Public victory, recognition and the pride of having won in front of everyone.

laurelWreath.title: The Laurel Wreath
laurelWreath.description: A laurel wreath on the wand and on the rider's head: victory earned and acknowledged in honor. The merit belongs to the one who deserves it.

victoriousRider.title: The Victorious Rider
victoriousRider.description: He rides with head high, red cloak in the wind: the confidence of someone who has won and knows that success brings responsibility.

whiteHorse.title: The White Horse
whiteHorse.description: The white mount, adorned in green: tamed energy and the purity of purpose that led to the conquest, guided by the rider and not the reverse.

crowdOfStaves.title: The Crowd of Staves
crowdOfStaves.description: Followers march on foot around him, raising their staves: personal success depends on the support of many. The glory is shared with those who walked alongside.

sevenOfWands.name: Seven of Wands
sevenOfWands.intro: On a hilltop, a man defends his position against six wands rising from below. Courage, firmness and the decision to hold what is yours even at a disadvantage.

defender.title: The Defender
defender.description: He stands alone on guard, looking down: one who holds a conviction often finds himself like this, at a disadvantage but upright.

sixWandsBelow.title: The Six Wands
sixWandsBelow.description: Six staves rise from below: challenges that give no respite and force a choice about what is worth defending. Pressure reveals what truly matters.

mismatchedShoes.title: The Mismatched Shoes
mismatchedShoes.description: He wears unmatched shoes, as if he had risen in a hurry: defense is not always perfect or prepared, and yet it holds.

highGround.title: The High Ground
highGround.description: The hill gives an advantage to whoever holds it: seeing farther and having ground underfoot. Inner steadiness is the safest terrain there is.

queenOfWands.name: Queen of Wands
queenOfWands.intro: Seated on a lion throne with a sunflower in hand and a black cat at her feet, the queen radiates confidence and warmth. Magnetism, generosity and a will that attracts rather than imposes.

sunflower.title: The Sunflower
sunflower.description: The flower that follows the Sun: vitality, optimism and abundance. The queen holds it effortlessly, as one who makes whatever she touches shine.

wandInHand.title: The Queen's Wand
wandInHand.description: The budding wand, steady in her right hand: creativity and will under control, energy placed in service of a clear purpose.

blackCat.title: The Black Cat
blackCat.description: The alert feline at the foot of the throne: intuition, independence and the queen's mysterious side, who senses before she sees and trusts what she perceives.

lionThrone.title: The Lion Throne
lionThrone.description: Lions carved into the back: courage and self-mastery. She rules with the serene strength of one who has nothing to prove to anyone.

eightOfWands.name: Eight of Wands
eightOfWands.intro: Eight wands cut across the sky in swift flight toward the ground, with no human figure in sight. Speed, messages and events arriving all at once, with the momentum of something that cannot stop.

eightWands.title: The Eight Wands
eightWands.description: Parallel and moving, the staves all advance in the same direction: aligned actions that gain speed and arrive with force.

openSky.title: The Open Sky
openSky.description: A clear blue sky with no clouds to block the way: nothing hinders the passage. It is the phase when paths open and obstacles recede.

river.title: The River
river.description: A watercourse runs through the landscape in the same direction as the wands: the natural flow of things, when you are in tune with it, speeds everything up.

greenHills.title: The Green Hills
greenHills.description: Fertile land and a modest house in the distance: the arrival point is welcoming. The haste leads somewhere concrete, with roots and a place to land.

nineOfWands.name: Nine of Wands
nineOfWands.intro: Wounded and bandaged, a man leans on his staff before a fence of wands. Weariness, caution and the persistence of someone who has faced much and still has not given up.

bandagedHead.title: The Bandaged Head
bandagedHead.description: The bandage reveals past battles: experience that leaves marks but also teaches. Each wound is a lesson that makes him more alert.

leaningWand.title: The Supporting Wand
leaningWand.description: He leans on a staff that was once a weapon: strength that once served attack now supports rest. Endurance is also knowing how to use what you have.

wandFence.title: The Fence of Wands
wandFence.description: Eight staves lined up behind him form a barrier: the defenses he built one by one along the way. They protect, but they also confine.

waryGaze.title: The Wary Gaze
waryGaze.description: He glances sideways, watching for a threat that may or may not come: the distrust of one who has been surprised before and now measures every step.

tenOfWands.name: Ten of Wands
tenOfWands.intro: Bent under the weight of ten bundled wands, a man walks toward the village in the distance. Overload, too much responsibility taken on, and the need to share the weight.

bundleOfWands.title: The Bundle of Wands
bundleOfWands.description: Ten staves carried together hide the man's face: when too much accumulates, the task begins to overshadow the one who carries it.

bentBack.title: The Bent Back
bentBack.description: The bowed body shows the cost of effort without pause: hard-won success exacts its price when you cannot put down what is already done.

distantVillage.title: The Distant Village
distantVillage.description: The houses are still far but visible: the end of the work is in sight. All that remains is deciding how to arrive without breaking along the way.

dustyPath.title: The Dirt Path
dustyPath.description: The narrow trail leads straight to the door: there are no shortcuts. Each step is unavoidable and each one counts, even with the burden on his shoulders.

pageOfWands.name: Page of Wands
pageOfWands.intro: A young man in a tunic patterned with salamanders gazes at the wand he holds, in the middle of the desert. Curiosity, enthusiasm and the message of a new idea asking to be explored.

salamanderTunic.title: The Salamander Tunic
salamanderTunic.description: The salamander, creature of fire, patterns the youth's clothing: the card's element lives in him, though he does not yet master his own flame.

wandGaze.title: The Contemplated Wand
wandGaze.description: He studies the staff like one examining a possibility: before acting, he looks at his own will and asks what to do with it.

featheredHat.title: The Feathered Hat
featheredHat.description: The feather in the hat is lightness and freedom: the open mind of the apprentice, ready to be carried off by the wind of a new idea.

desertPyramids.title: The Desert and the Pyramids
desertPyramids.description: Sand and pyramids behind him: an arid, ancient terrain where only the fire of initiative can make something grow. Everything is still to be done.

knightOfWands.name: Knight of Wands
knightOfWands.intro: A knight in armor and a salamander tunic charges on a rearing horse. Drive, adventure and an enthusiasm that does not weigh risk, but can trample whatever is in the way.

rearingHorse.title: The Rearing Horse
rearingHorse.description: The horse surges in fury, ready to bolt: the raw energy of fire, still waiting for a steady hand to direct it.

redPlume.title: The Red Plume
redPlume.description: The blazing plume on the helmet is boldness on display: the knight wants to be seen and recognized, and his enthusiasm is contagious.

salamanderSurcoat.title: The Surcoat of Fire
salamanderSurcoat.description: Yellow salamanders cover his chest: he wears his own element. Passion is on the surface, with no filter between desire and action.

desertRide.title: The Open Desert
desertRide.description: The ride crosses sand and pyramids: a long journey without shade, where only momentum keeps spirits up and the destination is still unclear.

kingOfWands.name: King of Wands
kingOfWands.intro: The king in a salamander-patterned mantle holds the budding wand, seated on a lion throne. Vision, charismatic leadership and a mastery of fire that inspires others to follow.

buddingSceptre.title: The Budding Sceptre
buddingSceptre.description: The staff still sprouts: the king has not forgotten that power springs from something alive. His command creates, not merely administers.

salamanderMantle.title: The Salamander Mantle
salamanderMantle.description: The mantle embroidered with salamanders shows fire embodied: he does not fear the flame because he has passed through it and turned it into authority.

lionThrone.title: The Throne of Lions and Salamanders
lionThrone.description: Lions and salamanders decorate the throne: royalty founded on courage and passion. The king's power is the sum of forces he has learned to guide.

crownGaze.title: The Crown and the Gaze
crownGaze.description: A flame-like crown and a gaze turned sideways and forward: he sees far and decides for the future, not just the moment.

aceOfCups.name: Ace of Cups
aceOfCups.intro: A hand emerges from a cloud offering an overflowing chalice while a dove lowers a wafer onto it. The beginning of a love, an intuition or a grace that pours out without measure.

handCloud.title: The Hand in the Cloud
handCloud.description: The gift descending from above: love and grace are not won, they are offered. The hand presents the chalice and waits for you to receive it.

overflowingChalice.title: The Overflowing Chalice
overflowingChalice.description: The full cup from which water spills: emotional abundance that cannot be contained and must be shared to stay alive.

doveWafer.title: The Dove and the Wafer
doveWafer.description: The dove brings the sacred disc marked with a cross: spirit blessing matter. Pure feeling is also a form of communion.

lotusPond.title: The Lotus Pond
lotusPond.description: Five streams of water fall into a pond of lilies: the five senses feeding the soul. From the calm depths of emotion bloom the flowers of perception.

twoOfCups.name: Two of Cups
twoOfCups.intro: A man and a woman exchange cups beneath the winged caduceus of Hermes. Mutual attraction, partnership and the pact of two who recognize one another in equality and respect.

cupExchange.title: The Exchange of Cups
cupExchange.description: Each offers and receives at once: a true bond is an exchange, never a possession. The cups meet at the center.

wingedCaduceus.title: The Caduceus and the Winged Lion
wingedCaduceus.description: Two entwined serpents and a winged lion's head: passionate desire (the lion) lifted by communication and awareness (the caduceus).

coupleWreaths.title: The Wreathed Couple
coupleWreaths.description: Both wear wreaths of foliage: a union that celebrates life and does not deny nature. They stand face to face, on the same level, without hierarchy.

houseHill.title: The House on the Hill
houseHill.description: In the background, a house among hills: the place this union may build. The card points to a shared future still taking shape.

threeOfCups.name: Three of Cups
threeOfCups.intro: Three women dance with raised cups among fruit and garlands. Shared joy, friendship and the celebration of a harvest nobody won alone.

raisedCups.title: The Raised Cups
raisedCups.description: Three toasts in the air, gathered at the center: joy multiplies when shared. A toast to life, to togetherness and to what has been achieved.

dancingWomen.title: The Three Dancers
dancingWomen.description: Hands joined in a circle, dressed in different colors: three people, three temperaments, one harmony. Friendship that unites without erasing differences.

flowerGarlands.title: The Flower Garlands
flowerGarlands.description: Crowns and garlands of flowers adorn the dance: the feast is also a ritual of beauty, with nature joining the gathering.

harvestFruits.title: The Harvest Fruits
harvestFruits.description: Pumpkins and fruit at the dancers' feet: abundance that came from work and time. The feast is gratitude for what has ripened.

fourOfCups.name: Four of Cups
fourOfCups.intro: A young man with crossed arms meditates under a tree, ignoring the three cups before him while a hand offers a fourth. Apathy, contemplation and the opportunity that goes unnoticed.

handFourthCup.title: The Hand and the Fourth Cup
handFourthCup.description: A hand emerges from a cloud offering one more cup: life keeps bringing new possibilities even when we are not looking.

threeCupsGround.title: The Three Cups on the Ground
threeCupsGround.description: Lined up before him, the cups he already has: what has been given becomes invisible when the mind only wants what is missing.

crossedArms.title: The Crossed Arms
crossedArms.description: A closed posture and lowered gaze: he shields himself from the world. Introspection helps, but it can become a wall when it prevents receiving.

tree.title: The Tree
tree.description: He rests at the foot of a sturdy tree: the refuge of pause. It is a legitimate time of reflection, so long as it does not turn into stagnation.

fiveOfCups.name: Five of Cups
fiveOfCups.intro: A cloaked figure in black mourns three spilled cups, without seeing the two still standing behind. Grief, regret and the choice to look at what remains.

blackCloak.title: The Black Cloak
blackCloak.description: A body wrapped in mourning, back turned to what remains: pain fills the whole space and prevents seeing beyond it.

spilledCups.title: The Spilled Cups
spilledCups.description: Three fallen cups and liquid run out: the loss is real and deserves to be felt. The card does not ask you to deny grief but to pass through it.

standingCups.title: The Two Standing Cups
standingCups.description: Full and steady behind him: what remains, waiting to be noticed. A shift in posture is enough to realize not everything was lost.

riverBridge.title: The River and the Bridge
riverBridge.description: A bridge over the river leads to a house in the distance: crossing grief is possible. The water separates, but there is a path to the other side.

sixOfCups.name: Six of Cups
sixOfCups.intro: Two children exchange a cup of flowers in an old village courtyard. Nostalgia, innocence and the sweetness of simple gestures that remind us who we were and what we can still give.

flowerCups.title: The Cups of Flowers
flowerCups.description: Six chalices overflow with white flowers: memories in bloom. What was once kept with care continues to bear fruit.

childrenGift.title: The Children and the Gift
childrenGift.description: The older one offers a cup to the younger: generosity without interest, care between generations. The purest kindness is learned early.

villageCourtyard.title: The Village Courtyard
villageCourtyard.description: Stone houses, a coat of arms and a familiar ground: the setting of childhood. A safe place to which memory returns in search of affection.

backgroundFigure.title: The Figure in the Background
backgroundFigure.description: A figure walks away in the distance, back turned: time passing, and the adult the child will become. Memory lives alongside the life that goes on.

sevenOfCups.name: Seven of Cups
sevenOfCups.intro: Before a dark silhouette, seven cups float among the clouds, each holding a different vision. Fantasy, many options and the need to tell dream from what is possible.

darkSilhouette.title: The Dark Silhouette
darkSilhouette.description: Seen from behind and faceless, the figure is us before our options: we contemplate everything and have not yet chosen anything. Doubt is part of desire.

veiledFigure.title: The Veiled Figure
veiledFigure.description: A form covered by a cloth in the central cup: the mystery that attracts and frightens. What has not yet revealed itself asks for courage to be uncovered.

serpentDragon.title: The Serpent and the Dragon
serpentDragon.description: Threatening visions among the promises: not everything that glitters is safe. Illusions carry hidden risks alongside their charm.

jewelsLaurel.title: The Jewels and the Laurels
jewelsLaurel.description: Jewels, a laurel wreath and a tower: wealth, glory and power promised. Grand desires that do not always rest on reality.

eightOfCups.name: Eight of Cups
eightOfCups.intro: Under an eclipsed moon, a man in a red cloak leaves eight neatly stacked cups behind and climbs toward the mountains. Walking away from what no longer satisfies, in search of deeper meaning.

departingMan.title: The Walker
departingMan.description: He leaves staff in hand without looking back: the silent decision of one who knows that staying would betray his own need.

stackedCups.title: The Eight Cups
stackedCups.description: Arranged, complete, yet with a gap in the middle: everything seems in order and yet the essential is missing. What was built does not fulfill.

eclipsedMoon.title: The Eclipsed Moon
eclipsedMoon.description: The moon with a face, partly covered by the sun: intuition and reason meet. The emotional cycle closes and another is about to begin.

mountainsRiver.title: The Mountains and the River
mountainsRiver.description: The path crosses water and climbs rock: the spiritual search demands crossings and effort. The destination is still out of sight.

nineOfCups.name: Nine of Cups
nineOfCups.intro: A satisfied man with crossed arms sits before nine cups arranged in an arc. The wish card: contentment, well-earned pleasure and the joy of being able to enjoy.

contentMan.title: The Satisfied Man
contentMan.description: Round belly and a quiet smile: he acknowledges what he has achieved. There is legitimate pleasure in simply enjoying what you have built.

arcOfCups.title: The Arc of Cups
arcOfCups.description: Nine cups lined up on the shelf, all in view: a fulfilled wish displayed with pride, as a symbol of what was reached.

blueDrape.title: The Blue Drape
blueDrape.description: Blue cloth covers the table and background: comfort, protection and emotional calm. Everything is in its place and nothing needs hiding.

goldenBackdrop.title: The Golden Backdrop
goldenBackdrop.description: A bright yellow background: the light of optimism and reward. Life shows its most generous face to those who knew how to wait.

tenOfCups.name: Ten of Cups
tenOfCups.intro: Beneath a rainbow of ten cups, a couple raises their arms while two children play before a house. Emotional fulfillment, family harmony and happiness that reaches everyone.

rainbowCups.title: The Rainbow of Cups
rainbowCups.description: Ten cups draw the arc that joins heaven and earth: a blessing that rewards and shelters. After the rain, the promise of a peaceful life.

embracingCouple.title: The Couple with Raised Arms
embracingCouple.description: Embracing, seen from behind with arms lifted: shared gratitude. They do not look at each other but in the same direction.

playingChildren.title: The Dancing Children
playingChildren.description: Two children play without hurry: happiness that renews itself across generations. A home is complete only when there is joy to carry on.

homeValley.title: The Home and the Valley
homeValley.description: A house among trees by the river: the home that shelters and the land that sustains. Roots, stability and the peace of belonging to a place.

pageOfCups.name: Page of Cups
pageOfCups.intro: A young man in a flowered tunic gazes at a fish emerging from his cup before the sea. An unexpected message, creative sensitivity and an invitation to take imagination seriously.

fishInCup.title: The Fish in the Cup
fishInCup.description: A creature of the unconscious appears without warning: an idea, a feeling or a dream asking to be seen. He meets it with wonder and tenderness.

lotusTunic.title: The Lotus Tunic
lotusTunic.description: Lotus flowers embroidered on his clothing: purity and spiritual sensitivity. The youth carries delicacy as part of his identity.

seaWaves.title: The Restless Sea
seaWaves.description: The waves behind him bring the emotional world in motion: the flow from which messages and intuitions arise that change the day.

blueHat.title: The Blue Hat
blueHat.description: A blue cap with trailing cloth: the light, creative mind of one who still plays with forms and daydreams.

knightOfCups.name: Knight of Cups
knightOfCups.intro: A knight in winged armor advances calmly, carrying his cup before him. Romance, a sincere offer and the delicacy of one who acts from the heart, in no hurry to conquer.

offeredCup.title: The Offered Cup
offeredCup.description: He extends it with both hands: a gesture of giving, not demand. The gift is the feeling itself, presented with respect.

wingedHelmet.title: The Winged Helmet
wingedHelmet.description: Wings on the helmet and the heels, like Mercury: imagination and messages that fly. Chivalry here serves ideal and inspiration.

whiteHorse.title: The Calm White Horse
whiteHorse.description: The mount walks at an easy pace: he chooses tenderness and patience. Emotion sets the rhythm, not ambition.

riverMountains.title: The River and the Hills
riverMountains.description: A stream winds between distant hills: the flow of feeling that crosses the landscape and carries the ride toward its destination.

queenOfCups.name: Queen of Cups
queenOfCups.intro: The queen contemplates an ornate closed cup, seated on a throne by the sea. Deep intuition, compassion and the ability to feel another without losing your own center.

ornateCup.title: The Closed Cup
ornateCup.description: Unlike the others, this cup has a lid and angels on the handles: sacred feeling kept with care. She holds it without spilling it.

shellThrone.title: The Shell Throne
shellThrone.description: A throne decorated with shells and winged children: the sea shapes it. Her power is sensitive and springs from attunement to the cycles of emotion.

tideShore.title: The Shoreline
tideShore.description: Her feet rest on pebbles with water lapping at the base of the throne: she lives on the threshold between the conscious (land) and the unconscious (sea).

crownVeil.title: The Crown and the Gaze
crownVeil.description: A fixed, absorbed gaze on the cup beneath a modest crown: inner attention is worth more than ruling others.

kingOfCups.name: King of Cups
kingOfCups.intro: The king sits on a throne floating on the restless sea, holding cup and sceptre. Mastery of emotion, compassionate wisdom and the calm of one who rules without denying depth.

cupAndSceptre.title: The Cup and the Sceptre
cupAndSceptre.description: One hand holds feeling, the other authority: the king balances heart and command and lets neither smother the other.

floatingThrone.title: The Throne on the Water
floatingThrone.description: The throne floats among waves: he keeps stability amid turbulence. Serenity is not the absence of storm but presence within it.

leapingFish.title: The Leaping Fish
leapingFish.description: A fish leaps beside the throne: the unconscious is a welcome visitor, not a threat. The king lives alongside his deepest impulses.

shipHorizon.title: The Ship on the Horizon
shipHorizon.description: A ship passes in the distance: the adventures of the outer world go on, while the king keeps the inner calm that serves as their harbor.

aceOfSwords.name: Ace of Swords
aceOfSwords.intro: A hand emerges from a cloud gripping a crowned sword flanked by laurel and palm. The moment of clarity: a truth that cuts through confusion and the victory of thought over doubt.

handCloud.title: The Hand in the Cloud
handCloud.description: Lucidity arrives as a gift and as a responsibility: the hand offers the sword, but truth serves only the one who wields it firmly.

crownedSword.title: The Crowned Sword
crownedSword.description: The crown at the tip of the blade: intellect raised to the service of good. A mind that decides with justice carries true authority.

laurelPalm.title: The Laurel and the Palm
laurelPalm.description: Branches of victory and peace hang from the crown: truth that wins without destroying. The triumph of thought also brings reconciliation.

barrenPeaks.title: The Barren Peaks
barrenPeaks.description: Bare mountains in the background: the landscape of pure thought is cold and demanding. Clarity has altitude, and thin air does not forgive illusion.

twoOfSwords.name: Two of Swords
twoOfSwords.intro: A blindfolded woman crosses two swords over her chest before a calm sea under a crescent moon. Stalemate, forced balance and a decision postponed for fear of looking.

blindfold.title: The Blindfold
blindfold.description: She chooses not to see: the blindfold shields from immediate pain but prevents knowing the options. Deciding blind is postponing the decision.

crossedSwords.title: The Crossed Swords
crossedSwords.description: Two blades in tense balance against her chest: the heart protected by reason but also held by it. Nothing advances or retreats.

crescentMoon.title: The Crescent Moon
crescentMoon.description: The new moon in the sky points to intuition yet to manifest: something is about to grow, provided she lets herself see.

calmSeaRocks.title: The Sea and the Rocks
calmSeaRocks.description: A calm sea with rocks in sight: the quiet surface hides dangers. The apparent peace depends on facing what lies submerged.

threeOfSwords.name: Three of Swords
threeOfSwords.intro: A red heart is pierced by three swords under clouds and rain. Grief, betrayal or a truth that hurts: pain that cannot be argued with and must be gone through to heal.

piercedHeart.title: The Wounded Heart
piercedHeart.description: The card does not soften: the heart is wounded and the pain is real. Acknowledging it is the first step, because what is denied becomes chronic.

threeSwords.title: The Three Swords
threeSwords.description: Three symmetrical blades enter together: pain that comes in one blow with many roots. Each sword names a wound: loss, word and truth.

rain.title: The Rain
rain.description: Rain falls without pause: sadness also cleanses. Tears are not weakness but the soul's way of washing what it cannot carry.

stormClouds.title: The Heavy Clouds
stormClouds.description: A gray sky covers everything: the storm is a state, not a destiny. Loaded clouds pass, even when they seem permanent.

fourOfSwords.name: Four of Swords
fourOfSwords.intro: A knight lies in effigy on a tomb beneath a stained-glass window, with three swords on the wall. A necessary pause, retreat and the rest that restores the mind after a battle.

stainedGlass.title: The Stained Glass
stainedGlass.description: A colored sacred scene filters the light: the faith and meaning that accompany rest. Silence is not emptiness but a space of healing.

effigyKnight.title: The Knight's Effigy
effigyKnight.description: Motionless, hands in prayer: the warrior lays down arms for a while. Withdrawing is also a form of courage and of strategy.

hangingSwords.title: The Swords on the Wall
hangingSwords.description: Three blades hung above: thoughts and battles in suspension. They are within reach, but for now no one needs to wield them.

swordBelow.title: The Sword Beneath the Tomb
swordBelow.description: A fourth sword rests alongside the sarcophagus: strength held in reserve and at hand. Rest includes preparing to return to action.

fiveOfSwords.name: Five of Swords
fiveOfSwords.intro: A man smiles holding three swords while two others walk away defeated. A doubtful victory, conflict won at any cost and the price of winning without generosity.

victor.title: The Victor
victor.description: The sidelong smile reveals satisfaction and contempt: he won, but he is alone. Winning the argument can cost the bond.

collectedSwords.title: The Collected Swords
collectedSwords.description: He takes the weapons of the defeated: triumph measured in spoils. One who gathers others' arms lives forever awaiting the next fight.

departingLosers.title: The Departing Losers
departingLosers.description: Two figures walk with lowered heads toward the sea: the consequences of defeat. The card reminds us every conflict leaves resentment.

stormySky.title: The Ragged Sky
stormySky.description: Long, restless clouds cut across the sky: the air is still tense after the clash. Even the winner finds no immediate calm.

sixOfSwords.name: Six of Swords
sixOfSwords.intro: A ferryman poles a hooded woman and child across rough water toward calm, with six swords in the hull. Crossing out of crisis: distance, transition and gradual recovery.

ferryman.title: The Ferryman
ferryman.description: Seen from behind, he pushes the boat with a pole: someone steers the crossing without demanding anything. Accepting help is part of recovery.

hoodedPassengers.title: The Hooded Passengers
hoodedPassengers.description: The woman and child travel in silence, covered: the pain is still private and carried with dignity. Leaving is also a way to protect those you love.

sixSwordsHull.title: The Six Swords
sixSwordsHull.description: Six blades stuck in the boat accompany the journey: memories and thoughts we carry. Leaving a place does not erase what we lived.

twoWaters.title: The Two Waters
twoWaters.description: The water on the left is turbulent, on the right calm: the before and the after. The change of state is gradual and already under way.

sevenOfSwords.name: Seven of Swords
sevenOfSwords.intro: A man tiptoes away carrying five swords and leaves two behind, with a camp in the background. Strategy, stealth and the dilemma between cunning and honesty.

sneakingMan.title: The Sneak
sneakingMan.description: He walks sideways, glancing back with a smile: he trusts his own cleverness. The card asks whether the shortcut is worth the risk of being found out.

fiveSwordsCarried.title: The Five Swords Carried
fiveSwordsCarried.description: He takes only what he can hold: you cannot win everything. Deciding what to carry is also deciding what to abandon.

swordsLeftBehind.title: The Two Swords Left Behind
swordsLeftBehind.description: Two blades stay stuck in the ground: what remained, forgotten or sacrificed. Every escape leaves traces that can give the fugitive away.

campTents.title: The Camp
campTents.description: Tents and figures in the distance: the group he slips away from unnoticed. The card speaks of secrets, broken trust and acting in hiding.

eightOfSwords.name: Eight of Swords
eightOfSwords.intro: A blindfolded, bound woman stands surrounded by eight swords on soaked ground. A sense of imprisonment, fear and the realization that the way out depends on your own perception.

boundBlindfold.title: The Blindfold and Bindings
boundBlindfold.description: Loose cloth on her body and eyes: these bonds are slack. What traps her is the belief there is no way out more than the ropes.

eightSwords.title: The Eight Swords
eightSwords.description: The blades form a fence but leave gaps: fear draws limits reality does not impose. Obstacles are less solid than they look.

wetGround.title: The Wet Ground
wetGround.description: Water covers her feet: emotions take over the terrain and slow each step. To get out, one must accept the mud.

castleOnCliff.title: The Castle on the Cliff
castleOnCliff.description: In the distance, high up, a fortress: safety is in sight. The way out exists, but it requires removing the blindfold and taking the first step.

nineOfSwords.name: Nine of Swords
nineOfSwords.intro: Sitting up in bed, a person hides her face in her hands beneath nine swords hung in the dark. Anxiety, guilt and the nights when the mind works against rest.

faceInHands.title: The Face in the Hands
faceInHands.description: She weeps without seeing anyone: the suffering is private and silent. Naming the anguish is the first move toward dissolving it.

nineSwordsWall.title: The Nine Swords
nineSwordsWall.description: Hung in the air without touching her: fears weigh more in imagination than in reality. The blades threaten, but have not yet fallen.

roseQuilt.title: The Rose Quilt
roseQuilt.description: Roses and astrological symbols embroidered on the blanket: love and destiny cover her even in the dark night. There is comfort in the bed itself.

carvedBed.title: The Carving on the Bed
carvedBed.description: A scene carved on the bedframe shows a fight and a fallen figure: the source of guilt lives in memory, replayed every night without resolution.

tenOfSwords.name: Ten of Swords
tenOfSwords.intro: A figure lies face down with ten swords in the back, under a black sky and a dawn on the horizon. The end of a painful cycle: the worst has passed, and something new begins to be born.

tenSwords.title: The Ten Swords
tenSwords.description: Excess and exhaustion: pain has reached its limit and can grow no more. The extreme, by itself, closes the cycle that produced it.

fallenFigure.title: The Fallen Figure
fallenFigure.description: The fallen body with its red cloak: total defeat that also frees. When nothing more can hold, what remains is to begin again from the ground.

dawnHorizon.title: The Dawn
dawnHorizon.description: A golden band on the horizon beneath the darkness: the deepest night precedes the day. Light is already on its way, though it does not yet warm.

blackSky.title: The Black Sky
blackSky.description: Total darkness above: the moment of despair. The card shows it without detour to say that it has a limit and that rock bottom exists.

pageOfSwords.name: Page of Swords
pageOfSwords.intro: A youth with windblown hair raises a sword on a hill among clouds and birds. Curiosity, vigilance and the agile mind that wants to learn, ask and discover.

raisedSword.title: The Raised Sword
raisedSword.description: Held in both hands, pointing upward: an alert mind ready to test ideas. The blade is still young and needs training.

windblownHair.title: The Windblown Hair
windblownHair.description: Wind tousles the youth's hair and his whole body: he is exposed to shifts of thought and mood. His mind never stands still.

birdsClouds.title: The Birds and the Clouds
birdsClouds.description: Birds cross the restless sky: thoughts that pass quickly, messages, news. Watching the mind is like watching a moving sky.

bendingTrees.title: The Bending Trees
bendingTrees.description: Trees bend in the background: the wind's force is great, but life adapts. Flexibility protects better than rigidity.

knightOfSwords.name: Knight of Swords
knightOfSwords.intro: A knight with raised sword gallops on a white horse as the wind bends the trees. Intellectual drive, quick decisions and a frankness that cuts, sometimes without measuring the impact.

raisedSword.title: The Raised Sword
raisedSword.description: Held high without hesitation: he attacks the issue head on. Clarity of purpose is great, but haste may wound those nearby.

gallopingHorse.title: The Galloping Horse
gallopingHorse.description: The white mount runs at its limit, hooves in the air: the speed of thought hurling forward without looking at the terrain.

windBentTrees.title: The Wind-Bent Trees
windBentTrees.description: The wind bows the trees: everything in the way feels the impact. The knight moves the environment around him, whether he means to or not.

stormClouds.title: The Torn Clouds
stormClouds.description: The swirling sky accompanies the ride: the debate is intense and the mental climate agitated. A storm of ideas, with lightning and thunder.

queenOfSwords.name: Queen of Swords
queenOfSwords.intro: The queen with a butterfly crown holds her sword up with one hand and opens the other, on a carved throne. Clarity, independence and the wisdom of one who learned from pain and speaks frankly.

uprightSword.title: The Upright Sword
uprightSword.description: The blade points upward, steady in her hand: clear judgment with no room for illusion. She decides with a cool head and a present heart.

openHand.title: The Open Hand
openHand.description: The other hand opens, receptive: she listens before judging. Truth needs room to listen, not only to speak.

cherubThrone.title: The Cherub Throne
cherubThrone.description: Cherubs and butterflies carved into the throne: innocence and transformation support her authority. She knows where her power comes from.

birdClouds.title: The Bird in the Clouds
birdClouds.description: A lone bird crosses the clear sky: perspective and freedom of thought. She observes from above without clinging to drama.

kingOfSwords.name: King of Swords
kingOfSwords.intro: The king with a butterfly crown holds a sword, seated on a throne beneath a cloudy sky. Intellectual authority, justice and the word that governs through logic and ethics.

judgeSword.title: The Judge's Sword
judgeSword.description: Held at his side like a sceptre: law comes before impulse. The king decides by principle rather than passing sympathy.

butterflyCrown.title: The Butterfly Crown
butterflyCrown.description: The symbol of the soul and of transformation crowns thought: a serene mind can change without losing steadiness.

carvedThrone.title: The Carved Throne
carvedThrone.description: A sober throne adorned with symbols of spirit: a solid structure for serious decisions, without ostentation or tyranny.

blueMantle.title: The Blue Mantle
blueMantle.description: The blue of air and mind covers the king: the calm of thought that weighs before speaking. The voice comes after hearing everything.

aceOfPentacles.name: Ace of Pentacles
aceOfPentacles.intro: A hand emerges from a cloud offering a golden pentacle above a flowering garden. A seed of prosperity: a concrete, material and promising opportunity that asks to be planted.

handCloud.title: The Hand in the Cloud
handCloud.description: The opportunity arrives as a gift: an invitation to receive and work with what is offered. The hand shows the pentacle, but it bears fruit only in the earth.

goldenPentacle.title: The Golden Pentacle
goldenPentacle.description: A coin marked with the five-pointed star: spirit incarnate in matter. True wealth is born from care for what is concrete.

flowerGarden.title: The Flowering Garden
flowerGarden.description: Lilies and roses in a tended bed: fertile ground already prepared. Good conditions help, but daily care is what makes things grow.

archMountains.title: The Arch and the Mountains
archMountains.description: An arch of foliage opens onto a path between mountains: the passage to a new stage. The seed promises what the journey will reveal.

twoOfPentacles.name: Two of Pentacles
twoOfPentacles.intro: A juggler in a tall hat balances two pentacles bound by a figure-eight ribbon amid big waves. Adaptation, flexibility and the art of keeping several fronts going without losing rhythm.

juggledPentacles.title: The Two Pentacles
juggledPentacles.description: One rises while the other falls: resources alternating between gain and spending. Continuous attention keeps either from dropping.

infinityRibbon.title: The Infinity Ribbon
infinityRibbon.description: The ribbon draws the lemniscate: endless motion, a continuous cycle of giving and receiving. Balance is a flow, not a fixed state.

shipsWaves.title: The Ships on the Waves
shipsWaves.description: Two ships rise and fall on high waves: the fluctuations of markets and of life. Whoever can dance with the swell does not sink.

tallHat.title: The Tall Hat
tallHat.description: A tall, light red hat: humor and lightness amid instability. Taking the work seriously, but not yourself.

threeOfPentacles.name: Three of Pentacles
threeOfPentacles.intro: In a Gothic hall, a craftsman works on the arch while a monk and a noble discuss the plan. Teamwork, shared mastery and the value of each contribution to a common work.

craftsman.title: The Craftsman
craftsman.description: On the bench, he carves with tools: practical skill gives form to the vision of others. Without craft, the project never leaves the paper.

carvedPentacles.title: The Pentacles on the Arch
carvedPentacles.description: Three pentacles carved in stone: the concrete result of the work. A well-made work leaves a lasting mark, visible to all who pass.

planPatrons.title: The Patrons with the Plan
planPatrons.description: The monk and the noble study the plan: design, sponsorship and guidance. Each contributes the knowledge the other lacks.

gothicArch.title: The Gothic Arch
gothicArch.description: A ribbed stone vault: structure that joins pieces upward. Lasting works depend on each stone supporting the next.

fourOfPentacles.name: Four of Pentacles
fourOfPentacles.intro: A seated man clutches a pentacle to his chest, has another on his head and two under his feet, before a city. Security, possession and the risk of closing off to protect what you have.

coinOnChest.title: The Pentacle on the Chest
coinOnChest.description: Clasped against his body: attachment to what he has. Security is legitimate, but when it is all that matters the heart narrows.

coinOnHead.title: The Pentacle on the Head
coinOnHead.description: A coin crowns his thoughts: a mind occupied with what he owns. Material goods govern decisions and narrow the view.

coinsUnderFeet.title: The Pentacles Under the Feet
coinsUnderFeet.description: Two coins plant his feet on the ground: a solid base, but also an anchor. He does not move because he has too much to lose.

cityBehind.title: The City Behind
cityBehind.description: The city thrives behind him, yet he avoids it: prosperity that cuts itself off from company. Wealth gains meaning when it circulates.

fiveOfPentacles.name: Five of Pentacles
fiveOfPentacles.intro: Two injured beggars walk through snow past an illuminated stained-glass window with five pentacles. Hardship, exclusion and shelter so near yet seemingly out of reach.

stainedGlassPentacles.title: The Stained Glass of Pentacles
stainedGlassPentacles.description: Five coins arranged like the Tree of Life in a lit window: the visible refuge. Help exists, but it asks that someone knock on the door.

shawledWoman.title: The Barefoot Woman
shawledWoman.description: Hunched in a shawl, barefoot on the snow: vulnerability carried without complaint. Poverty is not only lack of money but lack of welcome.

crutchesMan.title: The Man on Crutches
crutchesMan.description: He walks with difficulty beside her: shared pain. Even in want, companionship supports more than possessions.

snowNight.title: The Snow and the Night
snowNight.description: A cold, dark setting surrounds the scene: the chill of solitude. Whoever passes through feels every effort as heavy, but can also choose to ask for help.

sixOfPentacles.name: Six of Pentacles
sixOfPentacles.intro: A merchant in a red robe weighs coins on a scale and gives them to two kneeling beggars. Generosity, reciprocity and the fairness of giving and receiving in the right measure.

merchantScales.title: The Scales
merchantScales.description: Measuring before giving: conscious generosity assesses what each one needs. Justice is not making everything equal but giving what fits.

coinsGiven.title: The Coins Given
coinsGiven.description: A coin passes from the merchant's hand to the needy one: the flow that keeps wealth alive. What is shared returns in other forms.
